about.title: Research on AI for business legal work
about.text: LegalAI is a research project of FTU Tech Lab (FTL), Foreign Trade University, Hanoi: an AI legal platform that helps Vietnamese small and medium-sized enterprises draft, negotiate and perform commercial contracts and handle trade remedies and international trade issues.

limits.title: Limitations
limits.l1: This is a research pilot; answers may be wrong or incomplete. Check the cited sources before relying on them.
limits.l2: LegalAI is not a lawyer and does not give legal advice; important matters should be reviewed by an expert.
limits.l3: Confidence only measures how well the claims match the sources consulted – it does not guarantee a correct conclusion.
limits.l4: Official sources can be temporarily unavailable; the answer says so when that happens.
limits.l5: Scanned PDFs without a text layer are not supported yet.

advice.a: No. LegalAI is a research pilot that provides sourced information for reference, not legal advice. For high-value or high-risk matters, use the “Escalate to expert” button or consult a lawyer.

sources.q: Where does LegalAI get its information?
sources.a: It looks up official sources live when you ask: vbpl.vn (legal documents), the courts' precedent and judgment portals, the Trade Remedies Authority (trav.gov.vn), the Federal Register/govinfo, EUR-Lex, WTO ePing and trungtamwto.vn (FTA commitments). Every citation shows its source and lookup date.

confidence.a: Before answering, an automatic check compares each legal claim in the answer with the text fetched from the sources. The result (high, medium, low) appears under the answer with its reasons. It measures agreement with sources, not correctness.

data.a: Conversations and uploaded files are stored on the server running LegalAI. The text of a file is extracted on the server and sent with your question to the AI model deployed by FTU Tech Lab. You can delete conversations, export your data and revoke share links at any time. The detailed policy is still a draft.

model.q: Which AI model does LegalAI run on?
model.a: LegalAI runs on a large language model deployed by FTU Tech Lab; the Lab does not disclose the name of the underlying model. Your questions and the text of attached files are processed on infrastructure operated by FTU Tech Lab and its technical service providers to generate answers. The interface warns you before you send personal identifiers such as ID card or bank account numbers – only send them if really necessary.

access.a: During the pilot, accounts are created by an administrator (public sign-up is off). Request access via the contact email at the bottom of this page.

files.a: Upload .docx, .pdf, .txt or .md files up to 10 MB. Documents created by LegalAI export to .docx and .pdf, with a tracked-changes redline for every edit. Scanned PDFs are not supported yet.

language.q: Can I use it in English?
language.a: Yes. The interface is available in Vietnamese and English; you can ask in English and draft bilingual Vietnamese – English contracts in two columns.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: How LegalAI – a pilot by FTU Tech Lab, Foreign Trade University – collects and processes data when you use the service.

s1.p: Your email and a hashed password (the original password is never stored), display name and interface settings; conversation content; files you upload and the text extracted from them; documents LegalAI creates; expert escalation requests and replies.

s2.p: To answer your questions, create and edit documents at your request, forward requests to experts when you choose to, and improve the product as part of the research.

s3.h: AI model and technical service providers
s3.p: Your questions and the text of attached files are processed by the AI model infrastructure operated by FTU Tech Lab and its technical service providers to generate answers. The interface warns you before you send personal identifiers. When researching, LegalAI visits official source websites but does not send your personal data to them.

s4.p: Data is stored on the server running LegalAI. Sessions use httpOnly cookies; passwords are hashed with scrypt; connections from the Internet use HTTPS.

s5.p: FTU Tech Lab administrators may review conversations and uploaded documents for user support, quality and safety purposes. Every such access is logged (who viewed it, when, and what was viewed).

s6.p: You can view, export and delete your conversations, revoke share links and ask an administrator to delete your account.

s7.p: Data is kept for the duration of the pilot or until you delete it. Specific periods will be set in the final version.

s8.p: This policy may be updated; the final version will be published on this page.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: Conditions for using LegalAI during the research pilot of FTU Tech Lab, Foreign Trade University.

s1.p: LegalAI is a research tool that provides legal information for reference. It is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice.

s2.p: Accounts are created by an administrator during the pilot. You are responsible for keeping your password secret and for activity under your account.

s3.p: Do not use LegalAI for unlawful purposes, to evade legal obligations, or to submit content you are not entitled to share.

s4.p: Answers may be wrong, incomplete or out of date. Check the cited sources; you are responsible for how you use the information.

s5.p: Documents drafted by LegalAI are drafts for you to review and edit; have them reviewed by a qualified person before signing.

s6.p: The pilot service may be interrupted, changed or discontinued without notice.

s7.p: These terms may be updated; the final version will be published on this page.

logo.title: Logo
logo.lead: Mark + “LegalAI” wordmark. Use the colour version on light backgrounds, colour-on-dark or white on dark backgrounds, and black for single-colour print.
logo.rationale: LegalAI's mark is FTU Tech Lab's own TECHLAB logo (the official file, unchanged), centred on a square tile of the same red (#B71B21) so logo and tile read as one block. The header, footer and social images show the TECHLAB logo next to the LegalAI wordmark. The logo is an official raster, so there are no recoloured variants – use it on light or dark backgrounds only.

space.title: Clear space & minimum size
space.clear: Keep clear space of at least 1/4 of the mark's height around the logo.
space.min: Mark at least 16 px (the favicon uses a pixel-snapped drawing); horizontal lockup at least 96 px wide.

donts.title: Don'ts
donts.stretch: Don't stretch or distort the proportions.
donts.effects: Don't add shadows, outlines or effects.
donts.busy: Don't place it on busy, low-contrast backgrounds.
donts.combine: Don't merge it with the FTU emblem into a new logo.

color.title: Colour
color.lead: FTU red #C20B11 (taken from the University's official logo) is the only accent: primary buttons, the mark, links, focus rings and key highlights. Everything else is black, white and grey.
color.pairs: Colour pairs used in the interface (WCAG)
color.usage: Contrast ratios are computed from the hex values (WCAG 2.x formula). On dark backgrounds, red text and links use lighter tints (red 300/400) to meet AA; primary buttons keep #C20B11 with white text.

type.title: Typography
type.lead: Be Vietnam Pro (SIL Open Font License) – designed for Vietnamese with full diacritics. Bold headings with slightly tight tracking; body text at 15–16 px.
type.sampleLong: Hợp đồng mua bán hàng hoá quốc tế – điều khoản phạt vi phạm và bồi thường thiệt hại.

voice.title: Voice & tone
voice.lead: Clear, honest, grounded and respectful – in Vietnamese and in English.

clear.title: Clear
clear.text: Short sentences; explain terms when needed.
clear.do: “The buyer may terminate when the seller commits a fundamental breach.”

honest.title: Honest
honest.text: State limitations and how certain we are.
honest.do: “Confidence: medium – one claim was not found in the sources.”

grounded.title: Grounded
grounded.text: Every legal claim comes with a source.
grounded.dont: Quoting figures or penalty rates without a source.

respectful.title: Respectful
respectful.do: “You may want an expert to review this clause.”

endorse.title: Foreign Trade University logo
endorse.lead: LegalAI is a product of FTU Tech Lab, Foreign Trade University. The University's logo appears only in this endorsement area.
endorse.r1: Use the official logo file as is – no redrawing, recolouring, cropping or inverting.
endorse.r2: On dark backgrounds, place it on a white rounded plate.
endorse.r3: Keep it separate from the LegalAI logo; never combine them into one mark.
endorse.r4: Use the official TECHLAB logo file unchanged – no recolouring, cropping or stretching.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.note: SVG and PNG files of every logo version plus a README. The Foreign Trade University logo is not included.

company.codeMismatch: The tax code in the pasted text differs from the one looked up – it may be another company page.

risk.representative: The signatory differs from the legal representative – a valid power of attorney is needed.
risk.statusHigh: Status “{status}” – high risk, clarify before signing.
risk.statusVeryHigh: Status “{status}” – very high risk, do not sign.
risk.checksum: The tax code in the contract is invalid – ask the counterparty to confirm it.
risk.branch: A 13-digit code belongs to a dependent unit without legal personality – the contract should be in the company name (the branch signs under authorisation).
risk.conflict: {field}: the unofficial sources differ – confirm on an official portal.
risk.unclear: {field}: partial match or the sources disagree – confirm on an official portal.

tool.vbpl_find: Finds central legal documents on vbpl.vn by title or number.
tool.vbpl_document: Opens a document on vbpl.vn: attributes, legal status, list of articles.
tool.vbpl_article: Quotes one article verbatim with the document's legal status.
tool.vbpl_search_articles: Finds the articles of one document that contain a keyword.
tool.vbpl_history: Validity history and amending / replacing documents.
tool.vbpl_verify: Checks that a quote appears verbatim on vbpl.vn.
tool.chinhphu_search: Finds documents on vanban.chinhphu.vn (including very recent ones) by summary or number.
tool.chinhphu_document: Document attributes on vanban.chinhphu.vn and its list of articles (scanned PDF read with OCR).
tool.chinhphu_article: One article from the attached PDF, labelled as OCR text.
tool.chinhphu_search_articles: Finds the articles of one vanban.chinhphu.vn document that contain a keyword.
tool.chinhphu_verify: Checks that a quote appears in the vanban.chinhphu.vn full text.
tool.court_anle_document: Reads a precedent: status, situation, legal solution, verbatim text.
tool.court_judgment_document: Reads a judgment: parties, reasoning, decision, legal basis.
tool.trav_measures: Looks up trade-remedy measures in force (early-warning database).
tool.fedreg_document: Reads a Federal Register document: duty rates, margins, deposits.
tool.eurlex_document: Reads an EU act: Article 1, duty tables.
tool.fta_document: Reads an FTA text or file.
tool.tariff_vn: Looks up Vietnam's import / export tariff by HS code, with the legal basis.
tool.tariff_us: Looks up the US tariff (HTS – USITC) by HS code.
tool.tariff_eu: Looks up the EU tariff (TARIC via Access2Markets) by HS code.
tool.tariff_eu_requirements: EU import requirements (SPS, labelling, standards, documents) and VAT / excise by HS code (Access2Markets).
tool.tariff_search: Suggests HS codes from a product description.
tool.document_create: Creates a Word / PDF document (contract, report…).
tool.document_edit: Edits a created or uploaded document into a new version.
tool.document_read: Reads the content of a document.
tool.draft_write: Long drafting – writes sections in parallel.
tool.calc_eval: Exact calculator for amounts and rates.
tool.calc_interest: Computes interest, late-payment interest and penalties.
tool.calc_check_words: Checks an amount in words against the figure.
tool.calc_contract_check: Checks contract figures (price tables, payments, words).
tool.fx_rate: Looks up official exchange rates (SBV, Vietcombank).
tool.web_read: Reads a web page / PDF and flags official sources.
tool.grounding_check: Checks the answer against the sources consulted and computes confidence.
tool.expert_escalate: Escalates the question to a legal expert.
tool.clock_calc: Computes deadlines per the Civil Code, with public holidays.
tool.about_self: Information about the assistant and its limits.
tool.safety_scan: Safety check of content (prompt injection, personal data).
tool.question: Asks the user a clarifying question with choices.
tool.chrome_click: Clicks an element on the page.
tool.chrome_evaluate_script: Runs a script to extract page content.
tool.chrome_navigate_page: Opens an address in the current tab.
tool.chrome_press_key: Presses a key on the page.
tool.chrome_take_screenshot: Takes a screenshot of the page.
tool.chrome_take_snapshot: Reads the page structure and text.
tool.chrome_upload_file: Uploads a file to the page.
tool.chrome_wait_for: Waits for text to appear on the page.
tool.company_lookup: Checks a tax code and guides the company lookup on official portals; reads data the user pastes from the result page.
tool.company_verify: Compares a contract party's name, address and representative with the company record.
tool.diagram_create: Draws process, sequence and party-structure diagrams (layout-checked, PNG / SVG download).
